out.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether more optimisation pressure on debaters keeps judge accuracy high, for LLM debaters on QuALITY with an LLM judge

text: The paper reports self-play debates (copies of the same model play against each other) judged by GPT-4-Turbo, with separate questions used for self-play (TL) and cross-play (DL) matches, and notes a strong correlation between judge accuracy and debater aggregate rating: as debaters are optimised against win rate (judge preference), judge accuracy improves. The authors state this suggests training models to win debates may produce more truthful outcomes and provides weak evidence that debate produces truthful information under optimal play.
title: Self-play debate: judge accuracy rises with debater aggregate rating
